correctness.rationale: For m,n>=5, every closed neighborhood contains its center and four cardinal neighbors; the unique-center free-face matching removes 7 disjoint pairs per vertex (cardinal subsets of sizes four, three and opposite pairs of size two), leaving the grid graph and four triangles per square (two oriented disks D_f,E_f along the same perimeter). CW chain H2 consists of integral coefficients with a_f+b_f constant across all grid squares, since the primitive square boundary kernel of the torus is Z times the all-face fundamental cycle. This yields basis S_f=D_f-E_f, F=sum D_f and H2=Z^{mn+1}, H1=Z², no higher reduced H. Translation permutes S_f and fixes F; single-coordinate reflection sends S_f to S_hf and F to -F+sum S_f. An integral translation-invariant orientation-eigen lift F+c sum S_f requires 1+2c=0, impossible; 2F-sum S_f is an equivariant double-lift, so class has exact order two, rational split with c=-1/2. Independently checked all 210 free-face pairs and residual 4mn triangles for (m,n)=(5,6); source VERIFY.py signed-face procedure read but not run. No statement for m,n<5 or coordinate-interchange symmetry.
